organizations.title: Ƙungiyoyi
organizations.intro: Yi rijistar abokan hulɗa da ke aiwatarwa kuma ka kiyaye matsayin amincewarsu. Abokin hulɗa ba zai iya tsara aiki ko bayar da rahoto ba har sai an amince da ƙungiyar.
organizations.name: Sunan ƙungiya
organizations.focusHint: Rabata kowane fanni da waƙafi, misali gwaji, turawa.
organizations.pendingNote: Sabbin ƙungiyoyi suna farawa a matsayin ana jira. Jami'in PLACA ne ke amincewa da su kafin ma'aikatansu su iya bayar da rahoto.

organizations.empty: Babu ƙungiyar da ta dace da waɗannan zaɓin.

workplans.title: Tsare-tsaren aiki
workplans.intro: Tsara maƙasudin kwata bisa alama da Ƙaramar Hukuma. Mika tsarin don bitar PLACA; tsarin da aka amince da shi yana tsayawa don kwatanta rahotanni da shi.
workplans.empty: Babu tsarin aiki da aka ƙirƙira don waɗannan zaɓin.
workplans.emptyPartnerHint: Fara tsarin aiki don saita maƙasudi na kwata mai zuwa.
workplans.targetsHint: Ƙara layi ɗaya ga kowace alama da Ƙaramar Hukuma. Rubuta adadin mutane ko kayan da kake shirin kai wa a wannan kwata.
workplans.targetRequired: Ƙara aƙalla maƙasudi ɗaya cikakke kafin ajiyewa.
workplans.reviewHint: Duba cewa maƙasudan sun cika kuma suna da gaskiya. Idan wani abu ya canza, bayyana shi sarai kafin ka mayar da tsarin.
workplans.returnNote: Me abokin hulɗa ya kamata ya canza?

reports.title: Rahotanni
reports.intro: Rubuta lambobi na lokaci ɗaya. Ana duba lambobin don tabbatar da daidaito kafin a mika su. Ana ajiye lambobi kawai, ba sunaye ko sakamakon gwaji ba.

reports.emptyPartnerHint: Fara rahoto don aika lambobinka zuwa PLACA.
reports.countsHint: Bi fom ɗin kamar yadda takardar lissafi take: jimilla farko, sannan mata da maza, sannan rarraba shekaru. Bar fili fanko idan ƙungiyarka ba ta yi wannan aikin ba.
reports.breakdownPreserved: Ana kiyaye lambobin rarrabuwa da aka riga aka ajiye wa wannan rahoto idan ka canza jimillar.
reports.reviewHint: Kwatanta lambobi da takardar abokin hulɗa. Idan wani abu bai daidaita ba, bayyana shi kafin ka mayar da rahoton.

auditLogs.readOnlyBody: Wannan shafi na karatu ne kawai. Tsarin bayanai da kansa yana hana canza waɗannan layukan, don haka babu wani asusu da zai iya sake rubuta tarihin.

errors.AI_BLOCKED: Mataimakin bai iya amsa wannan buƙatar ba. Gwada yin tambaya ta wata hanya.
errors.AI_CONVERSATION_NOT_FOUND: Wannan tattaunawar ba ta wanzu ba.

notFound.title: Ba a sami shafin ba
notFound.intro: Shafin da ka nema babu shi.

assistant.title: Mataimakin AI
assistant.intro: Yi tambayoyi na gama-gari game da HIV da AIDS, lafiyar jama'a, hanyar bayar da rahoto ko yadda ake amfani da PLACA. Ana amsa cikin Turanci da Hausa.
assistant.disclaimerTitle: Yi amfani da amsa da hankali
assistant.disclaimer: Wannan mataimaki yana amfani da fasahar Gemini AI. Yana iya yin kuskure kuma amsoshinsa ba tabbatattu ba ne, ba na hukuma ba kuma ba shawara ta likita ba. Ba ya iya ganin asusunka ko wani bayanan PLACA na sirri. Kada ka rubuta sunaye, lambobin waya, adreshi, matsayin HIV ko wasu bayanan sirri. Tabbatar da muhimman bayanai da PLACA ko ma'aikacin lafiya ƙwararre.
assistant.privacyBody: Saƙonnin wannan tattaunawa ne kawai ake aikawa Gemini. Ba a aika sunanka, imel ɗinka, matsayinka, ƙungiyarka, LGA ɗinka ko bayanan PLACA ba.
assistant.noConversations: Babu tattaunawar da aka adana tukuna.
assistant.empty: Fara da tambaya. Za ka iya ci gaba da wannan tattaunawa da ƙarin tambayoyi.
assistant.generatedNotice: AI ce ta samar. Tabbatar da muhimman bayanai kafin yin aiki da su.
assistant.failed: Mataimakin bai iya amsawa ba. Don Allah sake gwadawa.
assistant.loadFailed: Ba a iya loda tattaunawar da aka adana ba.
assistant.conversationLoadFailed: Ba a iya loda wannan tattaunawa ba.
assistant.confirmDelete: A share wannan tattaunawa? Ba za a iya dawo da ita ba.
assistant.voiceOff: Dakatar da karantawa da babbar murya
assistant.voiceUnsupported: Shigar da murya baya samuwa a wannan burauza. Kana iya rubutawa.
assistant.voiceHint: Murya tana amfani da makirufo na burauzarka. Ba da izinin makirufo idan an tambaye ka.
assistant.voiceError: Shigar da murya ya tsaya. Kana iya sake gwadawa ko rubuta tambayarka.
assistant.micDenied: An hana amfani da makirufo. Ba da izini a burauzarka ko rubuta tambayarka.
assistant.micUnavailable: Ba a sami makirufo ba. Duba na'urarka ko rubuta tambayarka.
assistant.voiceInsecure: Shigar da murya na bukatar HTTPS (ko localhost). Bude wannan shafi cikin tsaro ko rubuta tambayarka.
assistant.voiceLanguage: Wannan burauza ba ta goyi bayan harshen muryar da aka zaɓa. Gwada Turanci ko rubuta tambayarka.
assistant.voicePlaybackError: Ba a iya karanta amsar da babbar murya a wannan na'urar ba. Rubutun yana sama.
assistant.languageNote: Harshen amsa zai bi harshen da ka zaɓa.
assistant.widgetDisclaimer: AI na iya yin kuskure. Amsoshi ba na hukuma ba ne kuma ba shawara ta likita ba. Kada ka raba bayanan sirri.
assistant.widgetPublicNote: Ba ka shiga ba. Ba a adana wannan tattaunawa ba kuma za ta ɓace idan ka bar shafin ko ka sabunta shi. Shiga domin adana tattaunawarka.
assistant.widgetAccountNote: An adana wannan tattaunawa a asusunka. Buɗe cikakken shafin mataimaki don ganin tattaunawarka na baya-bayan nan.
